content.title: 35 Tax Day Food Deals to Help You Make the Most of Your Refund
content.text: Whether you’re getting a hefty refund or you ended up owing money this year, submitting your annual tax return can make you feel like a weight has been lifted off your shoulders.Tax Day, which takes place on Wednesday, April 15, isn’t exactly an exciting holiday. But many restaurants and food brands are serving up sweet deals to help make filing your taxes feel like a bit less of a pain. Below, we’re sharing some of the top offers available this year.7-Eleven 7-Eleven customers can save $10.40 on any order of $25+ on April 15 in the 7NOW Delivery app with the code WRITEOFF.BJ’s Restaurant & BrewhouseBJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse customers can save $10 off a purchase of $40 while dining in or ordering takeout.California TortillaCalifornia Tortilla customers who make any purchase on April 15 can get a free small chips and queso (or chips and salsa). In stores, use the secret password “Government Cheese.” Online or in the chain’s app, use the code GOVCHEESE.Capriotti’s Sandwich ShopCapriotti’s rewards members can get a free combo upgrade (chips and a fountain drink) with the purchase of any sub on April 15.Church’s Texas ChickenChurch’s Texas Chicken rewards members can order an eight‑piece leg and thigh order for $4.99.Corner Bakery Cafe Corner Bakery Cafe is offering 15% off catering orders through April 15.Del TacoOn Tax Day, Del Taco is offering customers a free Snack Taco with a $5 purchase, a BOGO deal on Crispy Fish tacos and a $1 Grilled Chicken Taco.Freddy’s Frozen Custard & SteakburgersFreddy’s Frozen Custard & Steakburgers rewards users can score 250 bonus points with any purchase on April 15.GoldfishAs part of Goldfish’s Parent Tax Return, parents can visit GoldfishParentTax.com starting at 4:15 p.m. ET on April 15 to answer a few questions about their family’s snacking habits. If they’re eligible, they’ll get two free bags of Goldfish crackers, while supplies last.Grimaldi’s PizzeriaGrimaldi’s Pizzeria customers can save $10.40 off any purchase of $40+ all day on April 15. The offer is valid on dine-in, to-go and online orders with the code TAXDAY26 at all locations except the Brooklyn and Las Vegas Palazzo locations.GrubhubGrubhub is giving back $100,000 in Grubhub credit to 5,000 diners who paid delivery fees from any food delivery app in 2025.Now through April 15, customers can visit www.GrubhubFeeReturn.com and upload a 2025 receipt from any delivery app with fees for the chance to receive $20 in Grubhub credit.Huddle HouseHuddle House rewards members can earn double points on every purchase through April 15.Kona GrillOn April 15, Kona Grill restaurants will offer starters for $10.40 to dine-in guests all day long.KrogerBetween April 15 — April 22, Kroger customers can take advantage of a buy one, get one 50% off deal on Private Selection frozen meals (excluding frozen pizzas).Krispy KremeKrispy Kreme customers can take advantage of the following offer on April 15: Buy any dozen doughnuts and get a second Original Glazed dozen for free. This applies to orders in-shop, drive-thru, pickup or delivery through the chain’s app.Krispy Krunchy ChickenParticipating Krispy Krunchy Chicken locations are offering a value meal for $4.Maple Street Biscuit CompanyMaple Street Biscuit Company customers who dine and show proof of the chain’s Tax Day promotion can score three free Bonuts (biscuit/doughnut hybrid).Miami GrillMiami Grill is selling a $7.99 Chicken Pita + Fries special on April 15.Mountain Mike’s PizzaMountain Mike’s Pizza rewards members can save $10 off a minimum purchase of $40.Paris BaguetteParis Baguette rewards members can take home a free pasty with a beverage purchase on Tax Day.Pizza HutOn April 15, customers can snag a large, three-topping pizza starting at $10 on a choice of one of three crusts: the “new and improved” Hand Tossed, Tavern Style, or Thin ‘N Crispy.PopeyesOn April 15, Popeyes is offering customers a 25% off Tax Day 3-piece tenders combo (3-piece tenders, one regular side, one biscuit and a drink), available on its app or website.Plus, those who join the Popeyes loyalty program will unlock an additional, Cash App-only offer: a free chicken sandwich, 2-piece signature chicken, 3-piece tenders, fried pickles or 6-piece wings with their first digital purchase of $10 or more.Portillo’sBetween April 13 — 15, Portillo’s rewards members can get any slice of cake for $1 with a $5+ purchase.PotbellyPotbelly customers can get a free Original size sandwich or wrap with the purchase of any Big or Original size sandwich or wrap on April 15 with the code BOGO.QdobaQdoba rewards members who visit TaxDayGuacRelief.com by April 15 can save $5 off a full‑sized entrée between April 20 — 26.Shipley DonutsShipley Donuts rewards members can order a half dozen glazed doughnuts for $4.15 through April 15 in store.Smoothie KingAnyone who downloads the Smoothie King app and joins the chain’s rewards program can save $3 on April 15.Sonny’s BBQSonny’s BBQ customers can score a St. Louis Rib Dinner for $10.99 on April 15 for dine-in, takeout, drive-thru and online ordering.Stonefire GrillStonefire Grill is selling all sizes of the chain’s BBQ Chopped Salad and Fresh Baked Breadsticks for 50% off in person and online on Tax Day. In person, customers should mention the promo at the cash register. Online, they can use the code TAXDAY.SubwaySubway rewards members can get a free footlong sandwich with the purchase of another footlong with the code FLBOGO.Additionally, 1,040 customers who take advantage of the buy-one, get-one offer will get a full refund on their order, giving them both sandwiches for free.Taco CabanaTaco Cabana rewards members can take 15% off any purchase on April 15.Taco John’sTaco John’s rewards members can get a free small order of Potato Olés with any $3 purchase, redeemable by ordering on its app or website.Wendy’sWendy’s is offering customers a free 6-piece nuggets with a purchase of $5 via its app on April 15.White CastleWhite Castle is giving customers 15% off orders in-restaurant and online with the code WC15OFF until April 17.Ziggi’s CoffeeOn April 15, Ziggi’s Coffee is offering customers who make an in-store purchase a $2 “bounce back” coupon for their next visit.
